silhouette.reason: Standing wall stubs, a tower stub with a ragged crown and fallen scaffold poles (two crossed and leaning) read as a ruined build; the crossed poles read a little like an A-frame placed on purpose.
fixes: let the leaning poles rest on the wall top rather than meeting in mid-air

proportions.reason: 14.6 x 19.0 x 4.1 m; poles at scaffold length, blocks vary.
fixes: course-sized crown blocks on the tower stub

materials.reason: Stone stubs and timber poles read; the fallen team slates are clean saturated red, the floor the camouflage slab.

detail.reason: Wall stubs, crowned tower stub, fallen and leaning poles, planks, heaps of blocks and slates.
fixes: gravel and shards between the heaps

wear.reason: Raking.png and hero.png show crisp bevelled cube blocks, a little damp at the drum foot and no scorch, soot or ash anywhere; the fallen team slates are still bright saturated red, not dusty or charred. The collapse is told by arrangement only, not by surface.
fixes: scorch and soot on the broken wall tops and on the floor round the heap (rubble() in site.ts): dark, low-roughness patches that read at hero distance
dust/char coat on the fallen team slates (fallenSlabs) so the red reads buried, value down ~40%
chip one or two arrises per rubble block instead of whole clean cubes

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 (500 tris) keeps the walls, tower stubs, poles and a few slate shards; the heap thins and the tower crown flattens.
fixes: keep 3-4 heap blocks and a stepped crown at LOD2

technical.reason: QA PASS, tris 18.8k / 3.8k / 500, draws 2/2/2; one trim material + team slot, LOD2 well under 1k. Triangles mostly sit in the running-bond blocks and slates, where they show.
fixes: merge the per-block wall boxes into one course mesh per bay at LOD0 (shared inner faces removed) so the coursing costs fewer triangles
